diagnostics.message: The explicit `depends_on = [google_dns_managed_zone.dns_managed_zone]` on `google_dns_record_set.dns_record_set` is redundant. The resource's `for_each` uses `local.recordsets`, and its `name` attribute (`each.value.resource_name`) derives from `local.managed_zone.dns_name`; `local.managed_zone` resolves to `google_dns_managed_zone.dns_managed_zone[0]` (and the corresponding data source), so Terraform already infers the ordering implicitly. The mechanical graph misses this because the reference travels through `local` values, but the real attribute reference already establishes the same dependency the `depends_on` provides.
